data.summary: This directory contains core relational CSV datasets representing an e-commerce domain, including customers, products, orders, and order items. These files work together to form the data layer for sales and customer analytics.

file_insights.name: customers.csv
file_insights.summary: Stores customer demographic and membership information.
file_insights.source_summary: A comma-separated values file defining columns: customer_id, name, city, membership_tier, and updated_at, populated with sample customer records.
file_insights.detailed_description: This CSV file contains customer profile data including customer ID, name, city, membership tier, and last updated timestamps. It acts as the core database table for customer records in the e-commerce dataset.

file_insights.name: order_items.csv
file_insights.summary: Stores line item details for customer orders.
file_insights.source_summary: A comma-separated values file defining columns: order_item_id, order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price, and updated_at, populated with sample order item rows.
file_insights.detailed_description: This CSV file contains line item details for orders, mapping individual products and their quantities/unit prices to specific orders. It represents the transactional item details in the data layer.
responsibilities: Track quantities and unit prices for ordered items

file_insights.name: orders.csv
file_insights.summary: Stores order headers and statuses linked to customers.
file_insights.source_summary: A comma-separated values file defining columns: order_id, customer_id, order_status, ordered_at, and updated_at, populated with sample order records.
file_insights.detailed_description: This CSV file contains order header information, linking customer IDs to order statuses, order timestamps, and update timestamps. It acts as the core transaction table for order management.

file_insights.name: products.csv
file_insights.summary: Stores product catalog information and pricing.
file_insights.source_summary: A comma-separated values file defining columns: product_id, name, category, price, and updated_at, populated with sample product catalog rows.
file_insights.detailed_description: This CSV file contains product catalog data including product ID, name, category, unit price, and update timestamps. It serves as the master catalog table for products.
responsibilities: Track product pricing and update times
